rows: I often fixate on specific historical battles or wars and won't rest until my hoard contains that conflict's most significant artifacts.

Any creature that can hold their own against me must teach me how—whether they want to or not.
I cannot resist a game of dragonchess—which, I will have you know, my ancestors probably invented.
The sight of blood makes me queasy.

en.caption: Green Dragon Personality Traits
rows: You're either with me or you're against me. Just kidding—you're lunch either way!
I hate how much people think they matter in a world that was old before their kind even learned the idea of names.
The more the merrier as far as I'm concerned: more to control, more to torture, more to feast upon when I'm finally bored.
Bipedal life is too ugly and ignorant to merit even a scrap of compassion.
I like seeing life through the eyes of a lesser being—before forcing that creature to gouge their eyes out.
The wilds are mine and mine alone, and anyone who thinks they can enter my territory had best hope I have other distractions that day.
I allow others to dwell in my forest—if they act as my eyes, ears, and occasional playthings in return.
I harbor no animosity toward anyone. Let me grow ancient with my forest, and I'll leave you in peace.

rows: An amethyst dragon seeks a rare type of crystal found in the domain of a territorial stone giant clan.
A coven of hags seeks to reclaim its hag eye, which rests within an amethyst dragon's hoard.

An amethyst dragon seeks the means to plant special crystals that will allow the dragon to magically coexist in multiple places at once across the world during a rare celestial alignment.
An amethyst dragon is fusing with their echoes on other worlds. They all hope to ascend to godhood, perhaps recreating or replacing Sardior.

rows: Beauty. The ability to create, appreciate, and sustain beauty is the true measure of a creature or civilization. (Good)
Curiosity. The world holds so much to experience. I value different perspectives and insights. (Any)
Creativity. Our purpose is to create something new and clever, and I admire those who do so. (Any)
Change. The only constant is change, and we must change with the world. (Chaotic)
Fairness. Life is often unfair, and it is up to us to rebalance its scales from time to time. (Good)
Cruelty. Existence is a cruel joke. You can either be in on the joke, or be made a fool by it. (Evil)

en.caption: Emerald Dragon Ideals
rows: Seclusion. It's safer if others don't know I'm here—safer for me and safer for them. (Any)
Observation. People lie. Histories lie. Even dragons lie. But actions always ring true. (Lawful)
Storytelling. There is a magic in the retelling of stories. Each new teller adds a bit of themself to the spell. (Any)
Nurture. Rearing a child is our best chance to make sure our own stories are passed on. (Any)
Inquisitiveness. Even the smallest village contains myriad stories of love, loss, triumph, and betrayal. There is always more to learn about people. (Any)
Espionage. Once I get paid for the information I glean, I don't care what others do with it. (Evil)

A topaz dragon has developed a taste for merfolk, and the merfolk community near the dragon's lair is desperate for help.
A topaz dragon is intent on destroying the homes of all intelligent creatures in the dragon's territory, and desperate locals seek to find out what's behind the dragon's wrath.

rows: Posing as an avatar of an evil earth elemental-god, a sapphire dragon serves as general to a fanatical cult—and claims the spoils of the cult's victories.
A sapphire dragon is bound by an ancient pact to advise a monarchy on matters of defense—until someone bests the dragon's security measures.
A sapphire dragon seeks adventurers to lead into battle against the mind flayers that usurped the dragon's lair.

Powerful infernal creatures have opened a portal in the middle of a city square. The key to closing the portal is a mythical holy weapon that happens to be the pride and joy of a sapphire dragon's hoard.
A sapphire dragon threatens to sink a town into the Underdark unless the authorities find and turn over a thief who stole from the dragon.
A village is beset by swarms of giant spiders drawn to the area when a sapphire dragon took up residence nearby. Ridding the village of the spiders means tampering with the dragon's food supply.

A sapphire dragon invites warriors to vie for the honor of studying military tactics under the dragon. The front-runner is an infamous bandit leader who will undoubtedly terrorize the area if they win.

A sapphire dragon's lair is so well protected that its inner defenses have never been tested. The dragon spreads rumors of the treasures within to attract adventurers who can put the traps to the test.

en.caption: Faerie Dragon Personality Traits
rows: Some people say I have a short attention span, and that I'm easily distractible, but they don't... oh wow, is that a lute?
I do not constantly steal food. If you can't keep track of your rations, that's really a personal failing.
I'm much smarter than I look, and if you can't say the same, this is going to be a short conversation.
Elf, dwarf, horse—you non-dragons all look the same to me. No offense.
When I narrate what I'm doing in song, it makes everything feel more epic, don't you think?
The world is a product of my imagination. The fact that you think you exist when I'm not thinking about you is adorable.
I'm quick to make friends and love winning over grumpy and stoic types. If they don't yet appreciate my help, that just means they need more of it!
I like to earn people's trust, then lead them into dangerous situations and make off with their treasure while they're distracted.
en.name: Faerie Dragon Personality Traits

When I narrate what I'm doing in song, it makes everything feel more epic, don't you think?

I'm quick to make friends and love winning over grumpy and stoic types. If they don't yet appreciate my help, that just means they need more of it!
I like to earn people's trust, then lead them into dangerous situations and make off with their treasure while they're distracted.

en.caption: Undead Dragon Adventure Hooks
rows: A dragon seeks help, desperate to prevent a dracolich-worshiping cult from convincing the dragon's sibling, mate, or rival to become a dracolich.
A dragon suffering from a wasting affliction asks the characters to travel to another world, where they must destroy an echo of that dragon who has become a dracolich.
A pirate crew under the command of a {@creature ghost dragon|FTD} fights to recover the dead dragon's scattered hoard.

A {@creature hollow dragon|FTD} guards an artifact meant to be used in the dire circumstances foretold in an ancient prophecy. Now the prophecy is coming to pass, but the dragon won't let the artifact be used for its intended purpose.
A gem dragon from another world is searching for the dragon's echo, which has become a {@creature draconic shard|FTD}.

A dracolich keeps returning after being destroyed. The dracolich's connection to its echoes on other worlds is keeping its soul intact, like a phylactery, and the connection must be severed before the creature's threat can be ended.
en.name: Undead Dragon Adventure Hooks
